Safer, evidence‑safe substitutes (use verbatim where possible): replace "yields net employment gains" with "our modelling projects net employment gains on aggregate when combined with targeted policy supports"; replace "more than offset" with "are expected to offset many local losses in scenarios that mobilize private investment and place‑based packages"; replace "rapid recovery"/"materially shorten time‑to‑re‑employment" with "tend to shorten the duration of local unemployment in our case studies and modelled scenarios"; replace "prevent districts from being abandoned" with "ensure affected districts receive targeted, funded support."  
Top 3 camera‑ready Q&A lines (final edits): "This bill will not throw your district into mass unemployment—our internal modelling projects net job gains on aggregate and funds place‑based supports to protect affected districts."; "Where fossil jobs decline, the bill helps create durable, higher‑quality jobs in renewables, manufacturing and efficiency, and funds wage‑bridges and retraining so workers can move into them."; "Our hub’s managed‑transition examples show communities that used wage‑bridges, retraining and targeted investment recovered employment faster and with higher median wages than comparable places without those supports."
